_metadata.description: Restructured questionnaire based on workshop feedback suggestions

info.title: InsectAI hardware form - full version
info.description: A questionnaire to collect information about insect monitoring hardware devices for the InsectAI COST Action hardware database. For more details see: https://insectai-cost-action.github.io/hardware-db/

sections.title: Submission type
sections.description: Tell us whether you are submitting a new device or updating an existing entry.

questions.title: Is this a new device submission or an update to an existing entry?
questions.description: Select 'New device' if this is the first time you are registering this hardware. Select 'Update existing device' if you want to provide updated information for a device already in the database. A unique deviceID is automatically generated for new submissions. You can check existing entries at: https://insectai-cost-action.github.io/hardware-db/

sections.title: Existing device identifier
sections.description: Provide the deviceID of the entry you wish to update.

questions.title: Existing deviceID
questions.description: Enter the deviceID from your previous submission exactly as it appears (e.g. 'TrapCam_v1_Smith2023'). Check your confirmation email or browse the database at: https://insectai-cost-action.github.io/hardware-db/

sections.title: Basic information
sections.description: Core details about the device and its contact person.

questions.title: Contact person name
questions.description: The person who should be contacted about this database entry. This does not have to be the device designer — it can be a project manager, lab lead, or current maintainer.

questions.title: Contact email
questions.description: A valid email address (e.g. name@institution.org) for the contact person above. Used only for database management queries, not displayed publicly.

questions.title: Device name
questions.description: The common or published name of the device (e.g. 'AMI-trap', 'InsectDetect', 'PitfallCam'). If the device has no established name, use a short descriptive label.

questions.title: Device description
questions.description: A short abstract (max 300 characters) explaining what the device is and does, for a non-specialist audience. Focus on purpose and key features rather than technical specifications.

sections.title: People and project details
sections.description: Information about the people involved in designing, building, and maintaining the device.

questions.title: Contributor name (person filling in this form)
questions.description: May differ from the device designer if someone else is submitting on their behalf.

questions.title: Contributor email
questions.description: Email of the person filling in this form (e.g. name@institution.org).

questions.title: Institution name(s)
questions.description: Institution(s) affiliated with this device or project. Separate multiple entries with ';' (e.g. 'University of Edinburgh; NERC').

questions.title: Device designer(s)
questions.description: The person(s) who originally designed or built this device. Separate multiple names with ';' (e.g. 'Alan Turner; Dave Johnson').

questions.title: Device designer email(s)
questions.description: Email address(es) for the designer(s) above, in the same order, separated by ';'.

questions.title: Maintainer name
questions.description: The person currently responsible for maintaining or updating the device design. Leave blank if same as designer.

questions.title: Maintainer email
questions.description: Email of the device maintainer (e.g. name@institution.org).

questions.title: Project duration and team size
questions.description: Estimate of the time and people involved in developing this device (e.g. '2 years, 3 people' or '6 months, 1 person full-time + 2 part-time').

sections.title: Device links and documentation
sections.description: Links to external documentation, publications, and resources. We cannot host files directly — please provide URLs to externally hosted content (e.g. GitHub, Zenodo, institutional repositories).

questions.title: Documentation URL
questions.description: Link to the main documentation or repository for this device (e.g. GitHub repo, wiki, or project page).

questions.title: Documentation language
questions.description: Primary language of the documentation (e.g. 'English', 'French', 'German').

questions.title: DOI(s)
questions.description: Digital Object Identifier(s) for publications related to this device. Separate multiple DOIs with ';' (e.g. '10.1234/example1; 10.5678/example2').

questions.title: Additional resources
questions.description: Links to other relevant resources such as video tutorials, YouTube channels, blog posts, or community forums. Separate multiple URLs with ';'.

sections.title: Device details
sections.description: Physical characteristics, construction, and cost information for the device.

questions.title: Device version name
questions.description: A label for this specific version of the device (e.g. 'v2.1', '2024-field-edition'). Useful when multiple versions exist.

questions.title: Device licence (e.g. CC-BY-4.0)
questions.description: The licence under which the device design is released. Use a standard SPDX identifier where possible (e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0', 'CERN-OHL-S-2.0'). Leave blank if unknown.

questions.title: Device construction
questions.description: Select all that apply.
options: Modified off-the-shelf: Pre-built device with user-made adjustments
Partly custom: Assembled from off-the-shelf/open-source components with some user design (e.g. custom PCB, 3D-printed parts)
Fully custom: Designed and fabricated entirely by the user

questions.title: Primary material
questions.description: The main structural material of the device enclosure or chassis.

questions.title: Device mobility
questions.description: How the device is positioned or moves during deployment.

questions.title: Unit build cost (€) — hardware only
questions.description: Approximate cost of components, PCBs, enclosure, etc. for one unit.

questions.title: Deployment/seasonal costs (€)
questions.description: Consumables per deployment or season (batteries, lures, SIM data, etc.).

questions.title: Ongoing software/compute costs (€)
questions.description: Cloud services, subscriptions, or compute costs per year (if applicable).

questions.title: Assembly time/cost
questions.description: Estimated human-hours to assemble one unit (e.g. '4 hours', '2 days').

questions.title: Packaged dimensions for transport (L × W × H)
questions.description: Approximate dimensions in mm when the device is packed for transport (e.g. '300 × 200 × 150').

questions.title: Deployed dimensions (L × W × H)
questions.description: Approximate dimensions in mm when the device is set up and operational (e.g. '500 × 400 × 800').

questions.title: Skills and tools required for construction
questions.description: Select all skills/tools needed to build or assemble the device.

sections.title: Component details
sections.description: Technical specifications of the device's sensors, power system, processing, and connectivity.

questions.title: Power source(s)
questions.description: Select all power sources that can be used to operate the device.

questions.title: Power autonomy under continuous use
questions.description: How long the device can run on a single charge/battery set during continuous operation (e.g. '8 hours', '3 days'). Enter 'N/A' if grid-powered only.

questions.title: Power autonomy under standard use
questions.description: How long the device operates between charges under typical deployment conditions (e.g. motion-triggered, scheduled intervals). Enter 'N/A' if grid-powered only.

questions.title: Processing unit
questions.description: The main compute component (e.g. 'Raspberry Pi 4', 'NVIDIA Jetson Nano', 'Arduino Uno', 'ESP32'). Include model and version where known.

questions.title: Model processing
questions.description: Where detection or classification models are run. Select all that apply.
options: Offboard processing (data transfer to separate computer)

questions.title: Available image capture modes
questions.description: Select all image/video capture modes supported by the device.

questions.title: Sensor/lens field of view (FoV)
questions.description: The angular field of view of the main imaging sensor, if known (e.g. '120°', '62° horizontal'). State whether horizontal, vertical, or diagonal.

questions.title: Connectivity options
questions.description: Select all connectivity options available on the device.

questions.title: Supported file types
questions.description: Select all data file types produced by the device.

questions.title: On-device software version and repository link
questions.description: Version of the software running on the device and a link to its source repository, if available (e.g. 'v1.3.2 — https://github.com/org/repo').

questions.title: Attractants used
questions.description: Describe any attractants employed by the device (e.g. UV light, pheromone lure, sugar bait). Enter 'None' if no attractants are used.

sections.title: Maintenance and repairs
sections.description: Information about device upkeep, repairability, and firmware updates.

questions.title: Repairability score (1 = very difficult, 5 = very easy)
questions.description: 1 = requires soldering or specialist tools; 2 = requires tools but no specialist skills; 3 = screwdriver assembly, standard parts; 4 = snap-fit or modular replacement; 5 = fully tool-free, hot-swap components.

questions.title: Maintenance interval
questions.description: How often routine maintenance is needed (e.g. 'Clean lens every 2 weeks', 'Replace desiccant monthly', 'Battery swap every 3 days').

questions.title: Date of last firmware/software update
questions.description: Approximate date of the most recent firmware or software update (e.g. '2025-03', 'January 2026').

questions.title: Firmware update method
questions.description: Select all methods by which firmware can be updated on this device.

sections.title: Intended usage scope and operational constraints
sections.description: Information about where, how, and for what organisms the device is designed to be used.

questions.title: Target taxonomic group(s)
questions.description: Select all groups this device is designed or validated for.

questions.title: Habitat type(s)
questions.description: Select all habitat types where this device is designed to operate.

questions.title: Operational environment
questions.description: The broad environment category for device deployment.

questions.title: Minimum operational temperature (°C)
questions.description: The lowest ambient temperature at which the device functions reliably.

questions.title: Maximum operational temperature (°C)
questions.description: The highest ambient temperature at which the device functions reliably.

questions.title: IP rating (weatherproofing)
questions.description: The Ingress Protection rating, if known (e.g. 'IP65', 'IP67'). If no formal rating, describe the protection (e.g. 'splash-proof enclosure', 'fully sealed').

questions.title: Minimum detectable subject size (mm)
questions.description: The smallest organism or object size the device can reliably detect or image (in mm).

questions.title: Maximum detectable subject size (mm)
questions.description: The largest organism or object size the device is designed to capture (in mm). Leave blank if not applicable.

questions.title: Operational costs per season (€)
questions.description: Estimated total running costs for one typical deployment season. Include consumables (batteries, lures), cloud storage, SIM data, travel for maintenance, etc. Exclude the initial hardware build cost.
